episodes.title: A — spans + uneven pauses
episodes.synopsis: Each sentence synthesised separately, then spliced with pauses of 0.40 / 0.45 / 0.50 / 0.55 / 0.75 / 1.15 / 1.35 / 1.45 / 1.70 s — chosen by what the line is doing, not on a pattern. Room tone and an inhale in every gap over 0.70 s.

episodes.title: B — one pass (what you picked)
episodes.synopsis: The same ZONOS2 am_echo clone, but the whole script in a single call, so the breaks are the model's own punctuation pauses: short and evenly spaced.
